in_hebrew.name: Remington
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Remington הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old English name Reamund, meaning 'ruler of the land'. The name Remington has a rich history and was popular among the Anglo-Saxons. This strong and powerful name evokes images of leadership and strength.

in_latin.name: Remingtonus
in_latin.meaning: Name of English origin, possibly derived from Old English and Latin
in_latin.long_meaning: Remingtonus, nomen Anglicum, potest esse derivatum a lingua Anglica antiqua et Latina. Probabiliter significat 'locus fortis' aut 'vicus fortis'. In tempore Christiano, nomen hic non est notum, nisi possit referri ad Remigius, episcopus Rheims, qui fuit patronus sanctus in Ecclesia Catholica. In cultura moderna, nomen hic est utilis in America Septentrionali, potest significare 'fortitudo' aut 'potentia'.
